name: manual_c893d1
claim: When a canonical whole-manifest sync tool (sync-attribution-guard-scripts.sh) pulls in unrelated out-of-scope changes alongside the intended fix, revert to a narrow single-file hand-copy and explicitly flag the out-of-scope findings rather than silently including or silently dropping them

decisions.notes: On PT #355 (check_tdd_commit.sh bash 3.2 fix), the full manifest sync also touched pr-body-grant-lib.py (pre-existing reduced validation, not a regression) and surfaced a real banned-token finding in ci-bootstrap-private-attribution.sh that PT's stale scanner had been blind to. Neither was in scope for the one-file bug being fixed; both were named in the PR body as deferred follow-ups instead of silently swept in or silently discarded.
